# Synod standard library

Generated by `synod doc --catalog` for Synod 0.2. Do not edit.

## std/disk — storage that survives crashes

| Phrase | Gives | Context | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `disk.Write [v: value] at [k: text] on [n: node]` | — | node | Store `v` durably on `n`, which must be the receiver (instantly; records `disk.Written`) |
| `disk.Read [k: text] on [n: node] or [d: value]` | same as `d` | node | The value stored on `n`, or `d` when nothing is stored; the result has the type of `d` (`spec/04` §4.4) |

Trace events:

- `disk.Written [k: text] on [n: node]`: disk.Write v at k on n

## std/lesson — Predict mode and captions

| Phrase | Gives | Context | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `lesson.Ask [q: text]` | — | main | Emit `Asked` with no choices; the player pauses and asks the viewer to predict |
| `lesson.Ask [q: text] choosing [c: list of text]` | — | main | Emit `Asked` with the choices `c`: 2 to 6 distinct, non-empty texts, else `bad-argument`; the player pauses and offers them |
| `lesson.Note [t: text]` | — | main | Emit `Noted`; the player shows a caption |

Records:

- `lesson.Asked`: Question text, Choices list of text
- `lesson.Noted`: Text text

## std/lists

| Phrase | Gives | Context | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `lists.Size [l: list of value]` | number | any | Number of items |
| `lists.Append [x: value] to [l: list of value]` | same as `l` | any | A copy of `l` with `x` added at the end |
| `lists.Extend [a: list of value] with [b: list of value]` | same as `a` | any | A copy of `a` followed by every item of `b` |
| `lists.Without [x: value] from [l: list of value]` | same as `l` | any | A copy without any item equal to `x` |
| `lists.Take [n: number] from [l: list of value]` | same as `l` | any | The first `n` items (fewer if the list is shorter) |
| `lists.Range [a: number] to [b: number]` | `list of number` | any | Whole numbers from `a` to `b`, inclusive; empty when `a` is more than `b` |
| `lists.Sort [l: list of value]` | same as `l` | any | Ascending; items must all be numbers, all times or all text |

## std/look — shapes, motion, layout (look context only)

| Phrase | Gives | Context | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `look.Card for [n: node]` | shape | look | The standard node card: rounded rect, name label |
| `look.Travel [s: shape] from [a: shape] to [b: shape] over [d: time]` | — | look | Move along a straight path |
| `look.Remove [s: shape]` | — | look | Fade out, then delete |
| `look.Circle [r: number]` | shape | look | A circle of radius `r` points |
| `look.Rect [w: number] by [h: number]` | shape | look | A rounded rectangle |
| `look.Label [t: text]` | shape | look | Text |
| `look.Line from [a: shape] to [b: shape]` | shape | look | A line that follows both shapes |
| `look.Group [l: list of shape]` | shape | look | Shapes moved and faded together |
| `look.Fill [s: shape] with [c: color]` | — | look | Fill color (morphs) |
| `look.Stroke [s: shape] with [c: color]` | — | look | Outline color (morphs) |
| `look.Tween [p: text] of [s: shape] to [v: value] over [d: time]` | — | look | The only motion primitive (`spec/09`); of `"x"` or `"y"` it also takes a shape: that shape's position |
| `look.Effect [e: text] on [s: shape]` | — | look | `"glow"`, `"blur"` or `"trail"`, for 600ms |
| `look.Layout [kind: text]` | — | look | `"ring"`, `"row"` or `"grid"` for node cards |
| `look.Place [s: shape] above [t: shape]` | — | look | Position relative to another shape; likewise `below`, `beside` |
| `look.Place [s: shape] below [t: shape]` | — | look | Position relative to another shape: below |
| `look.Place [s: shape] beside [t: shape]` | — | look | Position relative to another shape: beside |
| `look.Center` | shape | look | An invisible point at the scene centre |
| `look.Orbit [s: shape] around [c: shape] at [f: number]` | — | look | Place on a circle of radius 300 around `c`, at fraction `f` of a turn (0 is 12 o'clock, clockwise) |
| `look.Flight [s: shape] from [a: shape] to [b: shape] for [m: msg]` | — | look | Move `s` from `a` to `b`, landing when `m` arrives (halfway when dropped) |
| `look.Fade [s: shape] to [o: number]` | — | look | Opacity over 300ms |
| `look.Pulse [s: shape]` | — | look | Scale to 1.15 and back over 300ms |

| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `maps.Keys [m: map of value to value]` | list of the key type of `m` | any | Keys in ascending order |
| `maps.Without [k: value] from [m: map of value to value]` | same as `m` | any | A copy without key `k` |

## std/math

| Phrase | Gives | Context | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `math.Floor [x: number]` | number | any | Round down |
| `math.Ceil [x: number]` | number | any | Round up |
| `math.Min of [a: number] and [b: number]` | number | any | Smaller |
| `math.Max of [a: number] and [b: number]` | number | any | Larger |
| `math.Remainder of [a: number] by [b: number]` | number | any | `a − b × floor(a / b)` |
| `math.Hash [t: text]` | number | any | A fixed number in [0, 1) from the text: FNV-1a 64-bit over its UTF-8 bytes, mixed with the MurmurHash3 64-bit finalizer, then `(h >> 11) / 2^53`. Not random: it never touches the PRNG. |

## std/net — the simulated network

| Phrase | Gives | Context | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `net.Send [m: msg] from [a: node] to [b: node]` | — | node | Send through the network from `a`, which must be the receiver |
| `net.Latency between [a: time] and [b: time]` | — | main | Uniform delay per message (default 10ms–30ms) |
| `net.Loss [p: number]` | — | main | Probability each message is lost (default 0) |
| `net.Partition [a: list of node] from [b: list of node]` | — | main | Cut every link between the two groups |
| `net.Heal` | — | main | Remove all partitions |
| `net.DropNext [type: text] from [a: node] to [b: node]` | — | main | Drop the next message of that record type (unqualified name) on that link |
| `net.Id [m: msg]` | number | look | The message id of the net fact that bound `m` |
| `net.Type [m: msg]` | text | look | The unqualified record type name of `m` |

Node event:

- `net.Received [m: msg] from [a: node]`: a message arrives at the receiving node

Trace events:

- `net.Sent [m: msg] from [a: node] to [b: node]`: net.Send m from a to b
- `net.Arrived [m: msg] from [a: node] to [b: node]`: the message is received
- `net.Dropped [m: msg] from [a: node] to [b: node] because [r: text]`: loss, partition, crash or net.DropNext
- `net.Partitioned [a: list of node] from [b: list of node]`: net.Partition
- `net.Healed`: net.Heal

## std/random — deterministic randomness

| Phrase | Gives | Context | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `random.Pick [l: list of value]` | item type of `l` | node, main | A uniformly chosen item; an `index-range` run-time error on an empty list |
| `random.Between [a: number] and [b: number]` | number | node, main | Uniform in [a, b) |
| `random.TimeBetween [a: time] and [b: time]` | time | node, main | Uniform in [a, b), whole microseconds |
| `random.Chance [p: number]` | bool | node, main | True with probability `p` |

## std/sim — nodes, runs, faults

| Phrase | Gives | Context | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sim.Seed [n: number]` | — | main | Sets the seed of the run's PRNG; `n` is a whole number from 0 to 2^53, otherwise `bad-argument`. The `--seed` flag, when given, wins over `sim.Seed`; without either the seed is 1. The trace header records the seed in force when `define main` returns. |
| `sim.StopAt [t: time]` | — | main | End the run at simulated time `t` |
| `sim.Spawn [p: package]` | `p.Node` | main | Create and start one node |
| `sim.Cluster of [count: number] running [p: package]` | `list of p.Node` | main | Create and start `count` nodes |
| `sim.Crash [n: node]` | — | main | Stop a node (`spec/07`) |
| `sim.Restart [n: node]` | — | main | Restart a crashed node with fresh state |
| `sim.Remove [n: node]` | — | main | Remove a node for good |
| `sim.Id [n: node]` | number | any | 1, 2, 3… in creation order |
| `sim.Name [n: node]` | text | any | `"n1"`, `"n2"`, … |
| `sim.Nobody` | node | any | The "no node" value |
| `sim.Nodes` | `list of node` | main, check, look | All nodes not removed, in creation order |
| `sim.NodesRunning [p: package]` | `list of p.Node` | main, check, look | Nodes running `p` |
| `sim.IsUp [n: node]` | bool | main, check, look | Not crashed and not removed |
| `sim.StateRows [n: node]` | `list of text` | look | One line per exported field of `n`: name and value as text |

Node event:

- `sim.Delivered [r: msg]`: a record injected with deliver

Trace events:

- `sim.Started`: the run starts
- `sim.Ended`: the run ends
- `sim.Added [n: node]`: a node is created
- `sim.Removed [n: node]`: a node is removed with sim.Remove
- `sim.Crashed [n: node]`: a node is stopped with sim.Crash
- `sim.Restarted [n: node]`: a node is restarted with sim.Restart
- `sim.Changed [f: field] of [n: node] from [old: value] to [new: value]`: set changes an exported node field
- `sim.Injected [r: msg] into [n: node]`: deliver injects a record from main
- `sim.Fired on [n: node]`: an after timer fires on a node
- `sim.Broken [rule: text]`: an always turns false
- `sim.Emitted [e: msg] by [n: node]`: emit e by n; n is sim.Nobody when main emits
- `sim.Failed [error: text]`: a run-time error stops the run
